content: Using this scheme we generate a collection of ranking examples (one for each document in the dataset, with the ranking of the best cluster matches), which are then trained using the SVMRank algorithm BIBREF3 . We run 5-fold cross-validation on this data to select the best model, and train both a separate model for each language according to INLINEFORM0 and a crosslingual model according to INLINEFORM1 .
